name: Tapioca Cream Custard
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: The beaten yolks of three eggs
ingredients.originalText: The beaten yolks of three eggs

instructions.text: Soak three heaping tablespoonfuls of tapioca in a teacupful of water over night
Place over the fire a quart of milk; let it come to a boil
Stir in the tapioca and a good pinch of salt, stir until it thickens
Add a cupful of sugar and the beaten yolks of three eggs
Stir it quickly and pour it into a dish
Stir gently into the mixture the whites beaten stiff, the flavoring and set it on ice, or in an ice chest

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak three heaping tablespoonfuls of tapioca in a teacupful of water over night
2. Place over the fire a quart of milk; let it come to a boil
3. Stir in the tapioca and a good pinch of salt, stir until it thickens
4. Add a cupful of sugar and the beaten yolks of three eggs
5. Stir it quickly and pour it into a dish
6. Stir gently into the mixture the whites beaten stiff, the flavoring and set it on ice, or in an ice chest
